user.title: Pair a Wellfed feeder
user.description: Make an invite on a paired client (`wellfed invite --role member`, or People in the app) and paste it here within 10 minutes. Home Assistant joins as its own client; it needs no server.

data_description.address: The feeder's IP address. Leave empty to find it on the network.

error.invalid_invite: That is not a Wellfed invite.
error.join_failed: The feeder did not accept the invite. It may have expired or been used already, so make a new one.

feed.name: Feed
feed.description: Dispense portions now. Sent once: a feed whose answer is lost is reported, never retried.
